newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ILIE HAT-TRICK PROPELS STEAU TO CUP TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ILIE HAT-TRICK PROPELS STEAU TO CUP TITLE.

text.p: Striker Sabin Ilie scored a hat-trick of goals to propel Steaua Bucharest to their 19th Romanian Cup title as they beat F.C. National 4-2 on Wednesday.
Ilie's scoring blitz completed a second hat-trick, following three-goal hauls in Steau's previous two league matches.
Ilie, 22, is the top scorer in the Romanian league with 29 goals in 32 matches.
With two matches remaining in the first division season, Steaua lead with 64 points, two points clear of F.C. National. The two teams meet on Saturday in a clash likely to decide the title.
